description: This is a PHP test class for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI, part of the OrangeHRM PIM API module. It contains unit tests for API endpoints related to employee immigration records, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI, testing various API endpoints and validation rules within the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordService

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee immigration record and verifies the returned normalized data.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an employee immigration record via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the API's validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee immigration record and verifies the returned normalized data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the API's validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee immigration record and verifies the returned normalized data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
